title: DEPR: revert deprecation of 'datetimetz' strings in select_dtypes (GH#68703)
body:
Reverts the unreleased deprecation of the `"datetimetz"` and `"datetime64tz"` specs in `DataFrame.select_dtypes` from GH-66666, per the discussion in GH-68703: these strings are the documented way to select tz-aware columns, and any deprecation of string aliases should be decided for all of them together. They continue to select the same columns as `pd.DatetimeTZDtype`.

AI disclosure: drafted with Claude Code (`claude opus 5.5 (high)`), which made the change and updated the tests, docstring and whatsnew.
